success.lede: Your message is in. I read every one personally.

faq.q: What happens after I send this?
faq.a: You'll get a personal reply (not a templated one) within 24 hours. If it looks like a fit, I propose a 30-minute discovery call. If it doesn't, I'll tell you and point you somewhere useful.

faq.q: Do I have to know my budget?
faq.a: No, but it helps. Even a rough number lets me suggest the right tier. "Not sure" is a fine answer — we'll figure it out on the call.
Yes, if you're near Tilburg, Eindhoven or Breda. Otherwise we work over video and shared docs — fine for 95% of projects.
Yes, mutual NDAs before discovery if your project needs it. Just mention it in the message.

footer.bio: Adrian Tajti. A one-person studio in Tilburg. I work with small businesses, mostly Dutch and Belgian, who want a real person to call when something on their site needs changing.
